origin: it should NOT report implicit use of `try`
source:
defmodule ModuleWithImplicitTry do
  def failing_function(first) do
    to_string(first)
  rescue
    _ -> :rescued
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report a violation in cases where we need `try`
source:
defmodule ModuleWithExplicitTry do
  def failing_function(first) do
    other_function()

    str =
      try do
        to_string(first)
      rescue
        _ -> "rescued"
      end

    to_atom(string)
  end
end

origin: it should report cases where a `try` block is the entire body of the function
source:
defmodule ModuleWithExplicitTry do
  def failing_function(first) do
    try do
      to_string(first)
    rescue
      _ -> :rescued
    end
  end
end

findings.message: Prefer using an implicit `try` rather than explicit `try`.

origin: it should report cases where a `try` block is the entire body of macro definition
source:
defmodule ModuleWithExplicitTry do
  defmacro failing_function(first) do
    try do
      to_string(unquote(first))
    rescue
      _ -> :rescued
    end
  end
end

findings.message: Prefer using an implicit `try` rather than explicit `try`.
